not_gates.test.yml/record-pass: Records a passed tree so the dev push can reuse its pull request result; it grades nothing.
not_gates.test.yml/refresh-durations: Runs only on a dev push to publish measured test durations.

outside_gate.equivalence.yml: Opt in replay of ledger storage and pages; the equivalence gate task wires it into the gate.
outside_gate.test-leaks.yml: Hour long single process sweep that runs on a schedule; its pull request run only exercises its own workflow.
